newsitem.title: USA: Sync Research says Dorf named CEO.
newsitem.headline: Sync Research says Dorf named CEO.

text.p: Sync Research said Monday its president and chief operating officer Roger Dorf, has been named chief executive officer.
Sync also said John Rademaker, Sync's founder, former CEO and a director of the company, will assume the title of vice chairman. Greg Reyes will continue in his role as chairman and director.

Sync Research develops and markets multi-service WAN access networking, digital transmission and circuit management products that enable corporations to migrate their business-critical wide-area networks to new, intelligent carrier services such as frame relay.
